intro: A highly motivated and enthusiastic undergraduate eager to begin a professional career in a reputable organization, applying academic knowledge, developing new skills and gaining valuable practical experience.
about:
I am K.W. Dilukshi Imansha Thilakarathne, a B.Com (Hons) undergraduate specializing in Business Technology Management at the University of Jaffna. I am seeking an opportunity to begin my professional career in a reputable organization where I can apply my academic knowledge, develop new skills and gain valuable practical experience.

I am eager to learn from experienced professionals, take on new challenges and improve my personal and professional abilities. With strong communication, teamwork, time management and problem-solving skills, I am committed to working responsibly, adapting to new environments and contributing positively to the growth and success of the organization.
contactIntro: I welcome opportunities to learn, contribute and grow. Feel free to reach out by email, phone or LinkedIn.
